sourceBindings.english: Register with the Department before beekeeping. Registration lasts 24 months from registration or renewal and must be renewed when it expires.

source.quote: Every person who carries out any beekeeping activities shall register with the Department. ... Registration shall be for a period of twenty four months from the date of registration or renewal of registration and shall be renewable on expiry of the registration period.
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019, control measures 2(1) and 2(4)

sourceBindings.english: A beekeeper who fails to renew registration at expiry will be deregistered and face penalties under the Act.

source.quote: In the case of failure to comply with control measure 2(4), a registered beekeeper shall be deregistered and shall face penalties in terms of the Act.
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019, control measure 2(5)

sourceBindings.english: Beekeeping activities and hired beekeeping services require a valid registration certificate. Check the certificate before using a beekeeper.

source.quote: No person may conduct any beekeeping activities unless they are in possession of a valid registration certificate issued in terms of control measure 2 (1). ... No person may utilise the services of a beekeeper for the purposes of carrying out any beekeeping activities unless the beekeeper is in possession of a valid registration certificate issued in terms of control measure 2 (1).
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019, control measures 2(8) and 2(9)

sourceBindings.english: Every beehive must be clearly and legibly marked with the beekeeper's registration number.

source.quote: Every beekeeper must mark his beehives to display clearly and legibly the registration number allocated to him in terms of control measure 2 (3).
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019

sourceBindings.english: Keep written records of colonies, apiary locations, diseases, disease-control measures and colony losses with their reasons.

source.quote: Every beekeeper shall, during the period of registration, keep written records of the— (a) number of colonies kept; (b) location of every apiary; (c) presence of any notifiable or other disease in the apiaries kept by the beekeeper; (d) management measures used to control any detected disease; and (e) number of colonies that ceased to exist, and the reasons for the loss.
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019

sourceBindings.english: Do not move honeybees across the Cape bee line, or keep Cape bees north of it, without written approval.

source.quote: No person may- (a)remove honey-bees across the line; ... (b)remove or keep Cape bees north of the line; (c)remove any Capensis-infected colony, without the prior written approval of executive officer.
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019

sourceBindings.english: Report any suspected notifiable disease (American foulbrood is listed); officials can order an infected colony destroyed.

source.quote: Every beekeeper shall notify the executive officer or area official of the presence or suspected presence of any notifiable disease or Capensis-infected colony ... instruct a beekeeper to destroy a colony, beehive or bee product.
source.doc: Department of Agriculture: Control Measures relating to honey-bees R.858 of 2013, consolidated with R.1511 of 22 November 2019

rows.zu: Imisebenzi yokufuya izinyosi nezinsizakalo zokufuya izinyosi eziqashwayo zidinga isitifiketi sokubhaliswa esisebenzayo. Hlola isitifiketi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umfuyi wezinyosi.
rows.st: Mesebetsi ya ho rua dinotshi le ditshebeletso tsa morui wa dinotshi ya hirwang di hloka setifikeiti sa ngodiso se sebetsang. Hlahloba setifikeiti pele o sebedisa morui wa dinotshi.
rows.ts: Mintirho yo fuwa tinyoxi ni vukorhokeri byo fuwa tinyoxi byo hirhiwa swi lava xitifikheti xa ntsariso lexi tirhaka. Kambela xitifikheti u nga si tirhisa mufuwi wa tinyoxi.
rows.ve: Mishumo ya u fuwa ṋotshi na tshumelo dza u fuwa ṋotshi dzi badelwaho zwi ṱoḓa ṱhanziela ya vhuḓiṅwalisi i shumaho. Ṱolani ṱhanziela musi ni sa athu shumisa mufuwi wa ṋotshi.

rows.english: Every beehive must be clearly and legibly marked with the beekeeper's registration number.
rows.zu: Isidleke ngasinye sezinyosi kufanele simakwe ngenombolo yokubhaliswa komfuyi wezinyosi ngendlela ecacile nefundekayo.
rows.st: Mokoko o mong le o mong wa dinotshi o tlameha ho tshwauwa ka nomoro ya ngodiso ya morui wa dinotshi ka ho hlaka le ka tsela e balehang.
rows.ts: Xisaka xin'wana ni xin'wana xa tinyoxi xi fanele ku funghiwa hi nomboro ya ntsariso ya mufuwi wa tinyoxi hi ndlela leyi vonakaka kahle ni ku hlayeka.
rows.ve: Ḓulu ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa ṋotshi ḽi tea u swaiwa nga nomboro ya vhuḓiṅwalisi ya mufuwi wa ṋotshi nga nḓila i vhonalaho zwavhuḓi nahone i vhaleaho.

rows.english: Keep written records of colonies, apiary locations, diseases, disease-control measures and colony losses with their reasons.
rows.zu: Gcina amarekhodi abhaliwe emihlambi yezinyosi, ezindawo zezidleke, ezifo, ezinyathelo zokulawula izifo nezokulahleka kwemihlambi nezizathu zako.
rows.st: Boloka direkoto tse ngotsweng tsa dihlopha tsa dinotshi, dibaka tsa mekoko, mafu, mehato ya taolo ya mafu le dihlopha tsa dinotshi tse lahlehileng hammoho le mabaka.
rows.ts: Hlayisa tirhekhodo leti tsariweke ta mintlawa ya tinyoxi, tindhawu ta swisaka, mavabyi, magoza yo lawula mavabyi ni ku lahlekeriwa hi mintlawa ya tinyoxi ni swivangelo swa kona.
rows.ve: Vhulungani rekhodo dzo ṅwalwaho dza zwigwada zwa ṋotshi, fhethu ha maḓulu, malwadze, maga a u langa malwadze na u xelelwa nga zwigwada zwa ṋotshi khathihi na zwiitisi zwazwo.

rows.english: Do not move honeybees across the Cape bee line, or keep Cape bees north of it, without written approval.
rows.zu: Ungadlulisi izinyosi ngaphesheya komugqa wezinyosi zaseKapa, noma ugcine izinyosi zaseKapa enyakatho yawo, ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe.
rows.st: O se ke wa tsamaisa dinotshi ho tshela moedi wa dinotshi tsa Kapa, kapa wa boloka dinotshi tsa Kapa ka leboya ho wona, ntle le tumello e ngotsweng.
rows.ts: U nga fambisi tinyoxi u tsemakanya ndzilakana wa tinyoxi ta Kapa, kumbe u hlayisa tinyoxi ta Kapa en'walungwini wa wona, handle ka mpfumelelo lowu tsariweke.
rows.ve: Ni songo pfukisa ṋotshi mutalo wa ṋotshi dza Kapa, kana na vhulunga ṋotshi dza Kapa devhula ha mutalo wonoyo, hu si na thendelo yo ṅwalwaho.

rows.english: Report any suspected notifiable disease (American foulbrood is listed); officials can order an infected colony destroyed.
rows.zu: Bika noma yisiphi isifo okusoleka ukuthi sikhona esidinga ukubikwa (i-American foulbrood isohlwini); izikhulu zingayala ukuba umhlambi wezinyosi onegciwane ubhujiswe.
rows.st: Tlaleha lefu lefe kapa lefe le belaellwang le lokelang ho tlalehwa (American foulbrood e lenaneng); bahlanka ba ka laela hore sehlopha sa dinotshi se tshwaeditsweng se fediswe.
rows.ts: Vika vuvabyi byihi kumbe byihi byo ehleketeleriwa ku va kona leri faneleke ku vikiwa (American foulbrood yi xaxametiwile); vatirhela-mfumo va nga lerisa leswaku ntlawa wa tinyoxi lowu tluleriweke wu lovisiwa.
rows.ve: Vhigani vhulwadze vhuṅwe na vhuṅwe vhu humbulelwaho vhune ha tea u vhigwa (American foulbrood i kha mutevhe); vhaofisiri vha nga laedza uri tshigwada tsha ṋotshi tsho kavhiwaho tshi fheliswe.

rows.english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: state Veterinary Services enforce isolation and movement restrictions.
rows.zu: Isifo samatele (FMD) siyisifo sezilwane esilawulwayo ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act: abezinsizakalo zikahulumeni zokwelapha izilwane baphoqelela ukuhlukaniswa nezithiyo zokuthutha.
rows.st: Lefu la tlhako le molomo (FMD) ke lefu la diphoofolo le laolwang tlasa Animal Diseases Act: ditshebeletso tsa mmuso tsa bongaka ba diphoofolo di qobella karohano le dithibelo tsa motsamao.
rows.ts: Vuvabyi bya nomu ni swondzo (FMD) i vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act: Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo bya Vutshunguri bya Swiharhi byi sindzisa ku hambanisa ni swipimelo swa ku fambisa.
rows.ve: Vhulwadze ha milenzhe na mulomo (FMD) ndi vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act: Tshumelo dza Muvhuso dza Vhulafhi ha Zwifuwo dzi kombetshedza u khethekanya na thivhelo dza u tshimbidza.

rows.english: Every cattle owner must register an official identification mark and brand or mark their cattle with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
rows.zu: Wonke umnikazi wezinkomo kufanele abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuhlonza bese eshisa noma emaka izinkomo zakhe ngalo, ngaphansi kwe-Animal Identification Act.
rows.st: Mong le e mong wa dikgomo o tlameha ho ngodisa letshwao la semmuso la boitsebahatso mme a tjhese kapa a tshwaye dikgomo tsa hae ka lona, tlasa Animal Identification Act.
rows.ts: N'wini un'wana ni un'wana wa tihomu u fanele ku tsarisa mfungho wa ximfumo wo ti tivekisa kutani a hisa kumbe a fungha tihomu ta yena ha wona, ehansi ka Animal Identification Act.
rows.ve: Muṋe muṅwe na muṅwe wa kholomo u tea u ṅwalisa luswayo lwa tshiofisi lwa u dzi ṱalula na u fhisa kana u swaya kholomo dzawe ngalwo, nga fhasi ha Animal Identification Act.

rows.english: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, as part of the national bovine brucellosis control scheme under the Animal Diseases Act.
rows.zu: Noma yikuphi ukuphunza kwezinkomo okusoleka noma okuqinisekisiwe ukuthi kuhlobene ne-brucellosis kufanele kubikwe ehhovisi likaDokotela Wezilwane Kahulumeni, njengengxenye yohlelo lukazwelonke lokulawula i-brucellosis yezinkomo ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act.
rows.st: Ho ntsha mpa ha dikgomo ho belaellwang kapa ho netefaditsweng hore ho amana le brucellosis ho tlameha ho tlalehwa ofising ya Ngaka ya Diphoofolo ya Mmuso, e le karolo ya leano la naha la taolo ya brucellosis ya dikgomo tlasa Animal Diseases Act.
rows.ts: Ku onhaka ka khwiri eka tihomu loku ehleketeleriweke kumbe ku tiyisisiweke leswaku ku fambisana na brucellosis ku fanele ku vikiwa ehofisini ya Dokodela wa Swiharhi wa Mfumo, ku ri xiphemu xa xikimi xa rixaka xo lawula brucellosis ya tihomu ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act.
rows.ve: U redza ha kholomo hu humbulelwaho kana ho khwaṱhisedzwaho uri hu tshimbidzana na brucellosis hu tea u vhigwa ofisini ya Dokotela wa Zwifuwo wa Muvhuso, sa tshipiḓa tsha tshikimu tsha lushaka tsha u langa brucellosis ya kholomo nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act.

rows.english: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, with the exception below.
rows.zu: Asikho isilwane esingahlatshwa kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwendawo yokuhlabela ebhalisiwe, ngaphandle kwalokhu okuchazwe ngezansi.
rows.st: Ha ho phoofolo e ka hlajwang sebakeng se seng ntle le sehlabelo se ngodisitsweng, ntle le mokgelo o ka tlase.
rows.ts: A ku na xifuwo lexi nga tlhaviwaka kun'wana handle ka laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona loku tsarisiweke, handle ka xiyimo lexi nga laha hansi.
rows.ve: A hu na tshifuwo tshi no tendelwa u ṱhavhiwa huṅwe hu si fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo ho ṅwaliswaho, nga nnḓa ha zwi re afho fhasi.

rows.english: Slaughter for the farmer's own household consumption, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
rows.zu: Ukuhlaba ukuze kudle umndeni womfuyi uqobo, noma ngezinjongo zamasiko noma zenkolo, akuboshwa umthetho wokusebenzisa indawo yokuhlabela.
rows.st: Ho hlaba bakeng sa dijo tsa lelapa la morui ka bolona, kapa bakeng sa merero ya setso kapa ya bodumedi, ho lokollotswe molaong wa sehlabelo.
rows.ts: Ku tlhava leswaku ku dya ndyangu wa murimi hi woxe, kumbe hi swikongomelo swa ndhavuko kumbe vukhongeri, a swi boheki hi nawu wa laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona.
rows.ve: U ṱhavhela zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa wa mulimi nga woṱhe, kana ndivho dza mvelele kana vhurereli, a zwi vhofhiwi nga mulayo wa fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo.

rows.english: Dairy farmers are legally required to test their herds for bovine TB, mainly because of export requirements, so most dairy cattle in South Africa are tested.
rows.zu: Abafuyi bezinkomo zobisi baphoqwa ngumthetho ukuba bahlolele imihlambi yabo i-TB yezinkomo, ikakhulu ngenxa yezidingo zokuthumela imikhiqizo emazweni angaphandle, ngakho izinkomo eziningi zobisi eNingizimu Afrika ziyahlolwa.
rows.st: Barui ba dikgomo tsa lebese ba tlamehile ka molao ho hlahloba mehlape ya bona bakeng sa TB ya dikgomo, haholo ka lebaka la ditlhoko tsa diyantle, kahoo dikgomo tse ngata tsa lebese Afrika Borwa di a hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Vafuwi va tihomu ta masi va boheka hi nawu ku kambela mintlhambi ya vona TB ya tihomu, ngopfungopfu hikokwalaho ka swilaveko swo rhumela ematikweni mambe, kutani tihomu to tala ta masi eAfrika-Dzonga ta kamberiwa.
rows.ve: Vhafuwi vha kholomo dza mafhi vha vhofhiwa nga mulayo u ṱola masambi avho TB ya kholomo, nga maanḓa nga ṅwambo wa ṱhoḓea dza u rengisela kha maṅwe mashango, ngauralo kholomo nnzhi dza mafhi Afrika Tshipembe dzi a ṱolwa.

rows.english: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, under the national bovine brucellosis control scheme.
rows.zu: Noma yikuphi ukuphunza kwezinkomo okusoleka noma okuqinisekisiwe ukuthi kuhlobene ne-brucellosis kufanele kubikwe ehhovisi likaDokotela Wezilwane Kahulumeni, ngaphansi kohlelo lukazwelonke lokulawula i-brucellosis yezinkomo.
rows.st: Ho ntsha mpa ha dikgomo ho belaellwang kapa ho netefaditsweng hore ho amana le brucellosis ho tlameha ho tlalehwa ofising ya Ngaka ya Diphoofolo ya Mmuso, tlasa leano la naha la taolo ya brucellosis ya dikgomo.
rows.ts: Ku onhaka ka khwiri eka tihomu loku ehleketeleriweke kumbe ku tiyisisiweke leswaku ku fambisana na brucellosis ku fanele ku vikiwa ehofisini ya Dokodela wa Swiharhi wa Mfumo, ehansi ka xikimi xa rixaka xo lawula brucellosis ya tihomu.
rows.ve: U redza ha kholomo hu humbulelwaho kana ho khwaṱhisedzwaho uri hu tshimbidzana na brucellosis hu tea u vhigwa ofisini ya Dokotela wa Zwifuwo wa Muvhuso, nga fhasi ha tshikimu tsha lushaka tsha u langa brucellosis ya kholomo.

rows.english: A cull cow may be slaughtered only at an abattoir, except for the farmer's own consumption or for cultural or religious purposes.
rows.zu: Inkomo esuswa emhlambini ingahlatshwa kuphela endaweni yokuhlabela, ngaphandle uma kungokokudla komfuyi uqobo noma ngezinjongo zamasiko noma zenkolo.
rows.st: Kgomo e tloswang mohlapeng e ka hlajwa feela sehlabelong, ntle le bakeng sa dijo tsa morui ka boyena kapa merero ya setso kapa ya bodumedi.
rows.ts: Homu leyi susiwaka entlhambini yi nga tlhaviwa ntsena laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona, handle ka loko ku ri swakudya swa murimi hi yexe kumbe hi swikongomelo swa ndhavuko kumbe vukhongeri.
rows.ve: Kholomo i bviswaho kha sambi i nga ṱhavhiwa fhedzi fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo, nga nnḓa ha zwiḽiwa zwa mulimi nga ene muṋe kana ndivho dza mvelele kana vhurereli.

rows.english: An owner or manager whose animals are, or may be, infected with a controlled animal disease must report it to the state veterinary director immediately.
rows.zu: Umnikazi noma umphathi onezilwane ezinesifo sezilwane esilawulwayo, noma okungenzeka zibe naso, kufanele akubike masinyane kumqondisi kahulumeni wezokwelapha izilwane.
rows.st: Mong kapa mookamedi eo diphoofolo tsa hae di tshwaeditsweng, kapa di ka bang di tshwaeditswe, ke lefu la diphoofolo le laolwang o tlameha ho tlaleha hanghang ho motsamaisi wa mmuso wa bongaka ba diphoofolo.
rows.ts: N'wini kumbe mufambisi loyi swifuwo swa yena swi tluleriweke, kumbe swi nga ha vaka swi tluleriwile, hi vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka u fanele ku swi vika hi ku hatlisa eka mulawuri wa mfumo wa vutshunguri bya swiharhi.
rows.ve: Muṋe kana mulanguli ane zwifuwo zwawe zwa vha zwo kavhiwa, kana zwi tshi nga vha zwo kavhiwa, nga vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho u tea u vhiga zwenezwo nga u ṱavhanya kha mulanguli wa muvhuso wa vhulafhi ha zwifuwo.

rows.english: Newcastle disease and notifiable avian influenza are on the state list of controlled and notifiable animal diseases.
rows.zu: Isifo se-Newcastle nomkhuhlane wezinyoni odinga ukubikwa zisohlwini lukahulumeni lwezifo zezilwane ezilawulwayo nezidinga ukubikwa.
rows.st: Lefu la Newcastle le mokgohlane wa dinonyana o lokelang ho tlalehwa di lenaneng la mmuso la mafu a diphoofolo a laolwang le a lokelang ho tlalehwa.
rows.ts: Vuvabyi bya Newcastle ni fluu ya tinyenyana leyi faneleke ku vikiwa swi le ka nxaxamelo wa mfumo wa mavabyi ya swiharhi lama lawuriwaka ni lama faneleke ku vikiwa.
rows.ve: Vhulwadze ha Newcastle na flu ya zwiṋoni ine ya tea u vhigwa zwi kha mutevhe wa muvhuso wa malwadze a zwifuwo a langiwaho na ane a tea u vhigwa.

rows.english: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but an abattoir, with the exceptions below.
rows.zu: Asikho isilwane esingahlatshwa kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwendawo yokuhlabela, ngaphandle kwezimo ezichazwe ngezansi.
rows.st: Ha ho phoofolo e ka hlajwang sebakeng se seng ntle le sehlabelo, ntle le mekgelo e ka tlase.
rows.ts: A ku na xifuwo lexi nga tlhaviwaka kun'wana handle ka laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona, handle ka swiyimo leswi nga laha hansi.
rows.ve: A hu na tshifuwo tshi no tendelwa u ṱhavhiwa huṅwe hu si fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo, nga nnḓa ha zwi re afho fhasi.

rows.english: Slaughter for your own household, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
rows.zu: Ukuhlaba ukuze kudle umndeni wakho uqobo, noma ngezinjongo zamasiko noma zenkolo, akuboshwa umthetho wokusebenzisa indawo yokuhlabela.
rows.st: Ho hlaba bakeng sa lelapa la hao ka bolona, kapa bakeng sa merero ya setso kapa ya bodumedi, ho lokollotswe molaong wa sehlabelo.
rows.ts: Ku tlhavela ndyangu wa wena hi woxe, kumbe hi swikongomelo swa ndhavuko kumbe vukhongeri, a swi boheki hi nawu wa laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona.
rows.ve: U ṱhavhela muṱa waṋu nga woṱhe, kana ndivho dza mvelele kana vhurereli, a zwi vhofhiwi nga mulayo wa fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo.

rows.english: Ducks are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so its rules on registered abattoirs and hygiene apply to them.
rows.zu: Amadada angolunye lwezinhlobo zezilwane ezifuywayo ezisohlwini lwe-Meat Safety Act, ngakho imithetho yawo yezindawo zokuhlabela ezibhalisiwe nenhlanzeko iyasebenza kuwo.
rows.st: Matata ke o mong wa mefuta ya diphoofolo tse ruuwang e lenaneng la Meat Safety Act, kahoo melao ya wona ya mahlabelo a ngodisitsweng le bohlweki e a a ama.
rows.ts: Masekwa i yin'wana ya tinxaka ta swifuwo leswi fuwwaka leswi xaxametiweke eka Meat Safety Act, kutani milawu ya wona ya tindhawu to tlhavela leti tsarisiweke ni mbhasiso yi tirha eka wona.
rows.ve: Masekwa ndi luṅwe lwa tshaka dza zwifuwo zwi fuwiwaho dzi re kha mutevhe wa Meat Safety Act, ngauralo milayo yawo ya fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo ho ṅwaliswaho na vhudele i a shuma khazwo.

rows.english: Ducks slaughtered to be sold must be slaughtered at a registered abattoir; slaughter for the farmer's own consumption is exempt but that meat may not be sold.
rows.zu: Amadada ahlatshwa ngenhloso yokuthengiswa kufanele ahlatshwe endaweni yokuhlabela ebhalisiwe; ukuhlaba ukuze kudle umfuyi uqobo akuboshwa yilokhu kodwa leyo nyama akufanele ithengiswe.
rows.st: Matata a hlajwang ho rekiswa a tlameha ho hlajwa sehlabelong se ngodisitsweng; ho hlaba bakeng sa dijo tsa morui ka boyena ho lokollotswe empa nama eo e ke ke ya rekiswa.
rows.ts: Masekwa lama tlhaveriwaka ku xavisiwa ma fanele ku tlhaveriwa laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona loku tsarisiweke; ku tlhavela swakudya swa murimi hi yexe a swi boheki hi leswi kambe nyama ya kona a yi fanelanga ku xavisiwa.
rows.ve: Masekwa a ṱhavhelwaho u rengiswa a tea u ṱhavhiwa fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo ho ṅwaliswaho; u ṱhavhela zwiḽiwa zwa mulimi nga ene muṋe a zwi vhofhiwi nga zwenezwi fhedzi ṋama yeneyo a i tei u rengiswa.

rows.english: At the abattoir, ducks must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
rows.zu: Endaweni yokuhlabela, amadada kufanele aphathwe ngobuntu ngesikhathi elayishwa, ethuthwa, ethululwa, ehlaliswa, eboshwa ukuba anganyakazi nalapho ebulawa, ngaphansi kwe-Animals Protection Act.
rows.st: Sehlabelong, matata a tlameha ho tshwarwa ka mosa nakong ya ho laelwa, ho tsamaiswa, ho theolwa, ho bolokwa, ho thibelwa ho sisinyeha le ho bolawa, tlasa Animals Protection Act.
rows.ts: Laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona, masekwa ma fanele ku khomiwa hi tintswalo loko ma layichiwa, ma fambisiwa, ma chichiwa, ma tshamisiwa, ma siveliwa ku famba ni ku dlayiwa, ehansi ka Animals Protection Act.
rows.ve: Fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo, masekwa a tea u farwa nga vhulenda musi a tshi laiwa, a tshi tshimbidzwa, a tshi tsitswa, a tshi dzudzwa, a tshi thivhelwa u tshimbila na u vhulawa, nga fhasi ha Animals Protection Act.

rows.english: Ducks are birds/poultry, so an outbreak of avian influenza in a duck flock is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act and must be reported to the state vet immediately.
rows.zu: Amadada ayizinyoni/izinkukhu ezifuywayo, ngakho ukuqubuka komkhuhlane wezinyoni emhlambini wamadada kuyisifo sezilwane esilawulwayo ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act futhi kufanele kubikwe masinyane kudokotela wezilwane kahulumeni.
rows.st: Matata ke dinonyana/dikgoho tse ruuwang, kahoo ho qhoma ha mokgohlane wa dinonyana mohlapeng wa matata ke lefu la diphoofolo le laolwang tlasa Animal Diseases Act mme le tlameha ho tlalehwa hanghang ho ngaka ya diphoofolo ya mmuso.
rows.ts: Masekwa i tinyenyana/tihuku leti fuwwaka, kutani ku hangalaka ka fluu ya tinyenyana entlhambini wa masekwa i vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act naswona byi fanele ku vikiwa hi ku hatlisa eka dokodela wa swiharhi wa mfumo.
rows.ve: Masekwa ndi zwiṋoni/kuku dzi fuwiwaho, ngauralo u phadalala ha flu ya zwiṋoni kha sambi ḽa masekwa ndi vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act nahone vhu tea u vhigwa nga u ṱavhanya kha dokotela wa zwifuwo wa muvhuso.

rows.english: The indigenous Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) is not a listed invasive species and may be farmed without an alien-species permit; the faster-growing Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) is.
rows.zu: I-Mozambique Tilapia yomdabu (O. mossambicus) ayikho ohlwini lwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo futhi ingafuywa ngaphandle kwemvume yezinhlobo ezivela kwamanye amazwe; i-Nile Tilapia ekhula ngokushesha (O. niloticus) yona ikulolo hlu.
rows.st: Mozambique Tilapia ya tlhaho (O. mossambicus) ha e lenaneng la mefuta e hlaselang mme e ka ruuwa ntle le tumello ya mefuta e tswang kantle; Nile Tilapia e holang kapele (O. niloticus) yona e lenaneng.
rows.ts: Mozambique Tilapia ya laha kaya (O. mossambicus) a yi xaxametiwanga ku va muxaka lowu hlaselaka naswona yi nga fuyiwa handle ka mpfumelelo wa muxaka lowu humaka ematikweni man'wana; Nile Tilapia leyi kulaka hi ku hatlisa (O. niloticus) yona yi xaxametiwile.
rows.ve: Mozambique Tilapia ya henefha (O. mossambicus) a i kha mutevhe wa tshaka dzi dzhenelelaho nahone i nga fuwiwa hu si na thendelo ya tshaka dzi bvaho nnḓa; Nile Tilapia i aluwaho nga u ṱavhanya (O. niloticus) yone i kha mutevhe wonoyo.

rows.english: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is a nationally listed invasive fish species: Category 1b inside National Parks, Provincial Reserves, Mountain Catchment Areas and Forestry Reserves, and Category 3 in all other areas.
rows.zu: I-Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) iwuhlobo lwenhlanzi oluhlaselayo olusohlwini lukazwelonke: Isigaba 1b emaPaki Kazwelonke, eziQiwini zezifundazwe, eziNdaweni zezintaba eziqoqa amanzi naseziQiwini zamahlathi, kanye neSigaba 3 kuzo zonke ezinye izindawo.
rows.st: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) ke mofuta wa tlhapi e hlaselang o lenaneng la naha: Sehlopha 1b Dipakeng tsa Naha, Dibakeng tsa Paballo tsa Diprofinse, Dibakeng tsa Dithaba tse Bokellang Metsi le Dibakeng tsa Paballo ya Meru, le Sehlopha 3 dibakeng tse ding tsohle.
rows.ts: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) i muxaka wa nhlampfi lowu hlaselaka lowu xaxametiweke erixakeni: Ntlawa 1b eka Tiphaka ta Rixaka, Tindhawu ta Vuhlayiselo ta Swifundzankulu, Tindhawu ta Tintshava to Hlengeleta Mati ni Tindhawu ta Vuhlayiselo bya Makhwati, na Ntlawa 3 eka tindhawu tin'wana hinkwato.
rows.ve: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) ndi lushaka lwa khovhe lu dzhenelelaho lu re kha mutevhe wa lushaka: Tshigwada 1b kha Phakha dza Lushaka, Fhethu ha Tsireledzo ha Mavundu, Fhethu ha Thavha hu Kuvhanganyaho Maḓi na Fhethu ha Tsireledzo ya Maḓaka, na Tshigwada 3 kha fhethu huṅwe hoṱhe.

rows.english: Outside protected areas Nile tilapia is Category 3: it may remain in prescribed areas or provinces, but further propagation or trade is prohibited.
rows.zu: Ngaphandle kwezindawo ezivikelwe, i-Nile tilapia ikuSigaba 3: ingahlala ezindaweni noma ezifundazweni ezibekiwe, kodwa ukuyandisa noma ukuyithengisa kuvinjelwe.
rows.st: Kantle ho dibaka tse sireleditsweng Nile tilapia ke Sehlopha 3: e ka dula dibakeng kapa diprofinsheng tse behilweng, empa ho e atisa hape kapa ho e hweba ho thibetswe.
rows.ts: Ehandle ka tindhawu leti sirhelelekeke Nile tilapia i Ntlawa 3: yi nga tshamisa eka tindhawu kumbe swifundzankulu leswi vekiweke, kambe ku yi andzisa nakambe kumbe ku yi xavisa swa yirisiwile.
rows.ve: Nga nnḓa ha fhethu ho tsireledzwaho Nile tilapia ndi Tshigwada 3: i nga dzula fhethu kana mavunduni o randelwaho, fhedzi u bvela phanḓa u i andisa kana u i rengisa zwo thivhelwa.

rows.english: Nile Tilapia has been listed under the NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations as requiring a permit to produce.
rows.zu: I-Nile Tilapia isohlwini ngaphansi kwe-NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations njengedinga imvume ukuze ikhiqizwe.
rows.st: Nile Tilapia e kentswe lenaneng tlasa NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations e le e hlokang tumello hore e hlahiswe.
rows.ts: Nile Tilapia yi xaxametiwile ehansi ka NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations leswaku yi lava mpfumelelo ku yi humelerisa.
rows.ve: Nile Tilapia yo ṅwalwa kha mutevhe nga fhasi ha NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations sa i ṱoḓaho thendelo uri i bveledzwe.

rows.english: Producing an alien or invasive species (such as Nile Tilapia) is prohibited in areas designated under the Protected Areas Act and the Fish Sanctuary Act; a permit is required to produce it elsewhere.
rows.zu: Ukukhiqiza uhlobo oluvela kwamanye amazwe noma oluhlaselayo (njenge-Nile Tilapia) kuvinjelwe ezindaweni ezibekwe ngaphansi kwe-Protected Areas Act ne-Fish Sanctuary Act; imvume iyadingeka ukuze lukhiqizwe kwenye indawo.
rows.st: Ho hlahisa mofuta o tswang kantle kapa o hlaselang (jwaloka Nile Tilapia) ho thibetswe dibakeng tse behilweng tlasa Protected Areas Act le Fish Sanctuary Act; tumello e a hlokahala ho o hlahisa sebakeng se seng.
rows.ts: Ku humelerisa muxaka lowu humaka ematikweni man'wana kumbe lowu hlaselaka (wo fana na Nile Tilapia) swa yirisiwa eka tindhawu leti vekiweke ehansi ka Protected Areas Act ni Fish Sanctuary Act; mpfumelelo wa laveka ku wu humelerisa kun'wana.
rows.ve: U bveledza lushaka lu bvaho nnḓa kana lu dzhenelelaho (sa Nile Tilapia) zwo thivhelwa fhethu ho randelwaho nga fhasi ha Protected Areas Act na Fish Sanctuary Act; hu ṱoḓea thendelo u lu bveledza huṅwe.

rows.english: Producing tilapia in South Africa requires a water use licence under the National Water Act.
rows.zu: Ukukhiqiza i-tilapia eNingizimu Afrika kudinga ilayisensi yokusebenzisa amanzi ngaphansi kwe-National Water Act.
rows.st: Ho hlahisa tilapia Afrika Borwa ho hloka laesense ya tshebediso ya metsi tlasa National Water Act.
rows.ts: Ku humelerisa tilapia eAfrika-Dzonga swi lava layisense yo tirhisa mati ehansi ka National Water Act.
rows.ve: U bveledza tilapia Afrika Tshipembe zwi ṱoḓa ḽaisentsi ya u shumisa maḓi nga fhasi ha National Water Act.

rows.english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: veterinary services enforce isolation and movement restrictions, and a suspected case must be reported.
rows.zu: Isifo samatele (FMD) siyisifo sezilwane esilawulwayo ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act: abezinsizakalo zokwelapha izilwane baphoqelela ukuhlukaniswa nezithiyo zokuthutha, futhi isigameko okusoleka ukuthi sikhona kufanele sibikwe.
rows.st: Lefu la tlhako le molomo (FMD) ke lefu la diphoofolo le laolwang tlasa Animal Diseases Act: ditshebeletso tsa bongaka ba diphoofolo di qobella karohano le dithibelo tsa motsamao, mme ketsahalo e belaellwang e tlameha ho tlalehwa.
rows.ts: Vuvabyi bya nomu ni swondzo (FMD) i vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act: vukorhokeri bya vutshunguri bya swiharhi byi sindzisa ku hambanisa ni swipimelo swa ku fambisa, naswona xiendlakalo lexi ehleketeleriwaka xi fanele ku vikiwa.
rows.ve: Vhulwadze ha milenzhe na mulomo (FMD) ndi vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act: tshumelo dza vhulafhi ha zwifuwo dzi kombetshedza u khethekanya na thivhelo dza u tshimbidza, nahone zwi humbulelwaho zwi tea u vhigwa.

rows.english: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products (including milk) cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
rows.zu: Endaweni emenyezelwe njengethinteke yi-FMD, izimbuzi nemikhiqizo yazo (kuhlanganise nobisi) azikwazi ukuthuthelwa ngaphakathi, ngaphandle, noma ngaphakathi kuleyo ndawo ngaphandle kwemvume yokuthutha kadokotela wezilwane kahulumeni nokulandela imigomo yayo.
rows.st: Sebakeng se phatlaladitsweng se amehileng ke FMD, dipodi le dihlahiswa tsa tsona (ho kenyeletswa lebese) di ke ke tsa iswa kahare, kantle, kapa kahare ho sebaka ntle le tumello ya motsamao ya ngaka ya diphoofolo ya mmuso le ho latela maemo a yona.
rows.ts: Endhawini leyi tivisiweke leswaku yi khumbekile hi FMD, timbuti ni swikumiwa swa tona (ku katsa masi) a swi nge fambisiwi ku nghena, ku huma, kumbe endzeni ka ndhawu handle ka mpfumelelo wo fambisa wa dokodela wa swiharhi wa mfumo ni ku landzela swipimelo swa wona.
rows.ve: Kha dzingu ḽo ḓivhadzwaho uri ḽo kwamiwa nga FMD, mbudzi na zwibveledzwa zwadzo (hu tshi katelwa mafhi) a zwi tei u tshimbidzwa u dzhena, u bva, kana ngomu ha dzingu hu si na thendelo ya u tshimbidza ya dokotela wa zwifuwo wa muvhuso na u tevhedza nyimele dzayo.

rows.english: Every goat owner must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
rows.zu: Wonke umnikazi wezimbuzi kufanele abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuhlonza bese emaka izimbuzi zakhe ngalo, ngaphansi kwe-Animal Identification Act.
rows.st: Mong le e mong wa dipodi o tlameha ho ngodisa letshwao la semmuso la boitsebahatso mme a tshwaye dipodi tsa hae ka lona, tlasa Animal Identification Act.
rows.ts: N'wini un'wana ni un'wana wa timbuti u fanele ku tsarisa mfungho wa ximfumo wo ti tivekisa kutani a fungha timbuti ta yena ha wona, ehansi ka Animal Identification Act.
rows.ve: Muṋe muṅwe na muṅwe wa mbudzi u tea u ṅwalisa luswayo lwa tshiofisi lwa u dzi ṱalula na u swaya mbudzi dzawe ngalwo, nga fhasi ha Animal Identification Act.

rows.english: A goat may only be slaughtered for sale at a registered abattoir under the Meat Safety Act (relevant when culled dairy does or male kids are sold for meat); slaughtering for the farmer's own consumption, or for cultural/religious purposes, is exempt but that meat may not then be sold.
rows.zu: Imbuzi ingahlatshwa ngenhloso yokuthengiswa kuphela endaweni yokuhlabela ebhalisiwe ngaphansi kwe-Meat Safety Act (lokhu kubalulekile lapho izinsikazi zobisi ezisuswa emhlambini noma amazinyane esilisa ethengiselwa inyama); ukuhlaba ukuze kudle umfuyi uqobo, noma ngezinjongo zamasiko/zenkolo, akuboshwa yilokhu kodwa leyo nyama akufanele ithengiswe.
rows.st: Podi e ka hlajwa ho rekiswa feela sehlabelong se ngodisitsweng tlasa Meat Safety Act (ho amang tse tshehadi tsa lebese tse tloswang mohlapeng kapa madinyane a matona a rekiswang bakeng sa nama); ho hlaba bakeng sa dijo tsa morui ka boyena, kapa merero ya setso/bodumedi, ho lokollotswe empa nama eo e ke ke ya rekiswa.
rows.ts: Mbuti yi nga tlhaveriwa ku xavisiwa ntsena laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona loku tsarisiweke ehansi ka Meat Safety Act (leswi khumbaka timbuti ta masi ta xisati leti susiwaka entlhambini kumbe swimbutana swa xinuna leswi xavisiwaka ku va nyama); ku tlhavela swakudya swa murimi hi yexe, kumbe hi swikongomelo swa ndhavuko/vukhongeri, a swi boheki hi leswi kambe nyama ya kona a yi fanelanga ku xavisiwa.
rows.ve: Mbudzi i nga ṱhavhelwa u rengiswa fhedzi fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo ho ṅwaliswaho nga fhasi ha Meat Safety Act (zwenezwi zwi a kwama tsadzi dza mafhi dzi bviswaho kha sambi kana vhana vha tshiduna vha tshi rengiselwa ṋama); u ṱhavhela zwiḽiwa zwa mulimi nga ene muṋe, kana ndivho dza mvelele/vhurereli, a zwi vhofhiwi nga zwenezwi fhedzi ṋama yeneyo a i tei u rengiswa.

rows.english: Every goat owner, including communal/smallholder owners, must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
rows.zu: Wonke umnikazi wezimbuzi, kuhlanganise nabanikazi bomphakathi/abafuyi abancane, kufanele abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuhlonza bese emaka izimbuzi zakhe ngalo, ngaphansi kwe-Animal Identification Act.

rows.ve: Muṋe muṅwe na muṅwe wa mbudzi, hu tshi katelwa vhaṋe vha zwifuwo zwa tshitshavha/vhafuwi vhaṱuku, u tea u ṅwalisa luswayo lwa tshiofisi lwa u dzi ṱalula na u swaya mbudzi dzawe ngalwo, nga fhasi ha Animal Identification Act.

rows.english: A goat may only be slaughtered for sale at a registered abattoir under the Meat Safety Act; slaughtering it for the farmer's own consumption, or for cultural/religious purposes (including ceremonial slaughter, common with indigenous goats), is exempt from that rule, but that meat may not then be sold.

rows.english: African swine fever (ASF) is listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act; warthogs and Ornithodorus ticks are carriers/vectors.
rows.zu: I-African swine fever (ASF) isohlwini lwezifo zezilwane ezilawulwayo ezithinta izingulube ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act; izingulube zasendle (warthogs) nemikhaza ye-Ornithodorus (Ornithodorus ticks) kuyizithwali/abasabalalisi.
rows.st: African swine fever (ASF) e lenaneng la mafu a diphoofolo a laolwang a amang dikolobe tlasa Animal Diseases Act; dikolobe tsa naha (warthogs) le dikgofa tsa Ornithodorus (Ornithodorus ticks) ke bajari/bafetisi.
rows.ts: African swine fever (ASF) yi xaxametiwile ku va vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka leri khumbaka tinguluve ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act; tinguluve ta nhova (warthogs) ni Ornithodorus ticks i swirhwali/swihangalasi.
rows.ve: African swine fever (ASF) i kha mutevhe sa vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho vhu kwamaho nguluvhe nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act; nguluvhe dza ḓaka (warthogs) na Ornithodorus ticks ndi zwithwali/zwiphaḓaladzi.

rows.english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is also listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act.
rows.zu: Isifo samatele (FMD) naso sisohlwini lwezifo zezilwane ezilawulwayo ezithinta izingulube ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act.
rows.st: Lefu la tlhako le molomo (FMD) le lona le lenaneng la mafu a diphoofolo a laolwang a amang dikolobe tlasa Animal Diseases Act.
rows.ts: Vuvabyi bya nomu ni swondzo (FMD) na byona byi xaxametiwile ku va vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka leri khumbaka tinguluve ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act.
rows.ve: Vhulwadze ha milenzhe na mulomo (FMD) na hone vhu kha mutevhe sa vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho vhu kwamaho nguluvhe nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act.

rows.english: Swill (food waste) may not be fed to pigs unless it has been boiled for at least 60 minutes or sterilised by another equally effective method.
rows.zu: Izinsalela zokudla akufanele ziphiwe izingulube ngaphandle uma zibiliswe okungenani imizuzu engu-60 noma zenziwe zangaba namagciwane ngenye indlela esebenza ngokulinganayo.
rows.st: Masalla a dijo a ke ke a fepjwa dikolobe ntle le haeba a bedisitswe bonyane metsotso e 60 kapa a bolailwe dikokwanahloko ka mokgwa o mong o sebetsang ka ho lekana.
rows.ts: Masalela ya swakudya a ma fanelanga ku phameriwa tinguluve handle ka loko ma virisiwile ku ringana kwalomu ka timinete ta 60 kumbe ma dlayiwile switsongwatsongwana hi ndlela yin'wana leyi tirhaka hi ku ringana.
rows.ve: Masalela a zwiḽiwa ha tei u ṋewa nguluvhe nga nnḓa ha musi o vhiliswa lwa tshifhinga tshi si fhasi ha minetse ya 60 kana o vhulahwa zwitshili nga iṅwe nḓila i shumaho nga nḓila i linganaho.

rows.english: Pigs may only be moved into a biosecure compartment from another compartment that is officially certified/approved for that purpose.
rows.zu: Izingulube zingathuthelwa egumbini elivikelwe ezifweni kuphela zivela kwelinye igumbi elinesitifiketi/elivunyelwe ngokusemthethweni ngaleyo njongo.
rows.st: Dikolobe di ka iswa karolong e sireleditsweng kgahlanong le mafu feela di tswa karolong e nngwe e netefaditsweng/amohetsweng ka molao bakeng sa morero oo.
rows.ts: Tinguluve ti nga nghenisiwa eka xiyenge lexi sirhelelekeke eka mavabyi ntsena ti huma eka xiyenge xin'wana lexi nga ni xitifikheti lexi nga xa ximfumo/lexi pfumeleriweke hi xikongomelo xexo.
rows.ve: Nguluvhe dzi nga tshimbidzelwa kha tshipiḓa tsho tsireledzwaho kha malwadze fhedzi dzi tshi bva kha tshiṅwe tshipiḓa tsho ṱhanzielwaho/tsho tendelwaho nga tshiofisi u itela ndivho yeneyo.

rows.english: A pig may not be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, except for own household consumption or cultural/religious purposes.
rows.zu: Ingulube akufanele ihlatshwe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwendawo yokuhlabela ebhalisiwe, ngaphandle uma kungokokudla komndeni womuntu uqobo noma ngezinjongo zamasiko/zenkolo.
rows.st: Kolobe e ke ke ya hlajwa sebakeng se seng ntle le sehlabelo se ngodisitsweng, ntle le bakeng sa dijo tsa lelapa la motho ka bolona kapa merero ya setso/bodumedi.
rows.ts: Nguluve a yi fanelanga ku tlhaviwa kun'wana handle ka laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona loku tsarisiweke, handle ka loko ku ri swakudya swa ndyangu wa munhu hi woxe kumbe hi swikongomelo swa ndhavuko/vukhongeri.
rows.ve: Nguluvhe a i tei u ṱhavhiwa huṅwe hu si fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo ho ṅwaliswaho, nga nnḓa ha zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa wa muthu nga woṱhe kana ndivho dza mvelele/vhurereli.

rows.english: A pig owner must apply to register an official identification mark and mark their pigs with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
rows.zu: Umnikazi wezingulube kufanele afake isicelo sokubhalisa uphawu olusemthethweni lokuhlonza bese emaka izingulube zakhe ngalo, ngaphansi kwe-Animal Identification Act.
rows.st: Mong wa dikolobe o tlameha ho etsa kopo ya ho ngodisa letshwao la semmuso la boitsebahatso mme a tshwaye dikolobe tsa hae ka lona, tlasa Animal Identification Act.
rows.ts: N'wini wa tinguluve u fanele ku endla xikombelo xo tsarisa mfungho wa ximfumo wo ti tivekisa kutani a fungha tinguluve ta yena ha wona, ehansi ka Animal Identification Act.
rows.ve: Muṋe wa nguluvhe u tea u ita khumbelo ya u ṅwalisa luswayo lwa tshiofisi lwa u dzi ṱalula na u swaya nguluvhe dzawe ngalwo, nga fhasi ha Animal Identification Act.

rows.english: Rabbits are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so the Act's rules on abattoirs and hygiene apply to them, as they do to ducks and other listed species.
rows.zu: Onogwaja bangolunye lwezinhlobo zezilwane ezifuywayo ezisohlwini lwe-Meat Safety Act, ngakho imithetho yawo yezindawo zokuhlabela nenhlanzeko iyasebenza kubo, njengoba isebenza emadadeni nakwezinye izinhlobo ezisohlwini.
rows.st: Mebutlanyana ke o mong wa mefuta ya diphoofolo tse ruuwang e lenaneng la Meat Safety Act, kahoo melao ya wona ya mahlabelo le bohlweki e a e ama, jwaloka ha e ama matata le mefuta e meng e lenaneng.
rows.ts: Mimpfundla i yin'wana ya tinxaka ta swifuwo leswi fuwwaka leswi xaxametiweke eka Meat Safety Act, kutani milawu ya wona ya tindhawu to tlhavela ni mbhasiso yi tirha eka yona, ku fana ni le ka masekwa ni tinxaka tin'wana leti xaxametiweke.
rows.ve: Mivhuḓa ndi luṅwe lwa tshaka dza zwifuwo zwi fuwiwaho dzi re kha mutevhe wa Meat Safety Act, ngauralo milayo yawo ya fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo na vhudele i a shuma khayo, sa zwine ya shuma kha masekwa na dziṅwe tshaka dzi re kha mutevhe.

rows.english: Rabbits slaughtered to be sold must be slaughtered at a registered abattoir; slaughter for the farmer's own consumption is exempt from this rule but the meat from it may not be sold.
rows.zu: Onogwaja abahlatshwa ngenhloso yokuthengiswa kufanele bahlatshwe endaweni yokuhlabela ebhalisiwe; ukuhlaba ukuze kudle umfuyi uqobo akuboshwa yilowo mthetho kodwa inyama yakhona akufanele ithengiswe.
rows.st: Mebutlanyana e hlajwang ho rekiswa e tlameha ho hlajwa sehlabelong se ngodisitsweng; ho hlaba bakeng sa dijo tsa morui ka boyena ho lokollotswe molaong oo empa nama ya hona e ke ke ya rekiswa.
rows.ts: Mimpfundla leyi tlhaveriwaka ku xavisiwa yi fanele ku tlhaveriwa laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona loku tsarisiweke; ku tlhavela swakudya swa murimi hi yexe a swi boheki hi nawu wolowo kambe nyama ya kona a yi fanelanga ku xavisiwa.
rows.ve: Mivhuḓa i ṱhavhelwaho u rengiswa i tea u ṱhavhiwa fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo ho ṅwaliswaho; u ṱhavhela zwiḽiwa zwa mulimi nga ene muṋe a zwi vhofhiwi nga mulayo wonoyo fhedzi ṋama yayo a i tei u rengiswa.

rows.english: At the abattoir, rabbits (like other listed animals) must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
rows.zu: Endaweni yokuhlabela, onogwaja (njengezinye izilwane ezisohlwini) kufanele baphathwe ngobuntu ngesikhathi belayishwa, bethuthwa, bethululwa, behlaliswa, beboshwa ukuba banganyakazi nalapho bebulawa, ngaphansi kwe-Animals Protection Act.
rows.st: Sehlabelong, mebutlanyana (jwaloka diphoofolo tse ding tse lenaneng) e tlameha ho tshwarwa ka mosa nakong ya ho laelwa, ho tsamaiswa, ho theolwa, ho bolokwa, ho thibelwa ho sisinyeha le ho bolawa, tlasa Animals Protection Act.
rows.ts: Laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona, mimpfundla (ku fana ni swifuwo swin'wana leswi xaxametiweke) yi fanele ku khomiwa hi tintswalo loko yi layichiwa, yi fambisiwa, yi chichiwa, yi tshamisiwa, yi siveliwa ku famba ni ku dlayiwa, ehansi ka Animals Protection Act.
rows.ve: Fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo, mivhuḓa (sa zwiṅwe zwifuwo zwi re kha mutevhe) i tea u farwa nga vhulenda musi i tshi laiwa, i tshi tshimbidzwa, i tshi tsitswa, i tshi dzudzwa, i tshi thivhelwa u tshimbila na u vhulawa, nga fhasi ha Animals Protection Act.

rows.english: The wild European rabbit (the same species as farmed New Zealand White/Californian rabbits) is only listed as an invasive species under NEMBA on South Africa's off-shore islands - it is not a listed/restricted species on the mainland.
rows.zu: Unogwaja wasendle waseYurophu (uhlobo olufanayo nonogwaja abafuywayo be-New Zealand White/Californian) usohlwini lwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo ngaphansi kwe-NEMBA kuphela eziqhingini zaseNingizimu Afrika ezisolwandle ngaphandle kwezwekazi - awulona uhlobo olusohlwini/olubekelwe imingcele ezwenikazi.
rows.st: Mmutlanyana wa naha wa Yuropa (mofuta o tshwanang le mebutlanyana ya New Zealand White/Californian e ruuwang) o lenaneng la mefuta e hlaselang tlasa NEMBA feela dihlekehlekeng tsa Afrika Borwa tse hole le lebopo - ha se mofuta o lenaneng/o thibetsweng naheng e kgolo.
rows.ts: Mpfundla wa nhova wa Yuropa (muxaka lowu fanaka ni mimpfundla ya New Zealand White/Californian leyi fuwwaka) wu xaxametiwile ntsena ku va muxaka lowu hlaselaka ehansi ka NEMBA eswihlaleni swa Afrika-Dzonga swa le lwandle - a hi muxaka lowu xaxametiweke/wu pimeriweke etikweni lerikulu.
rows.ve: Muvhuḓa wa ḓaka wa Yuropa (lushaka lu fanaho na mivhuḓa ya New Zealand White/Californian i fuwiwaho) u kha mutevhe wa tshaka dzi dzhenelelaho nga fhasi ha NEMBA fhedzi kha zwiṱangadzime zwa Afrika Tshipembe zwi re lwanzheni - a si lushaka lu re kha mutevhe/lu thivhelwaho kha shango ḽihulwane.

rows.english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act; Veterinary Services enforce isolation and movement restrictions.
rows.zu: Isifo samatele (FMD) siyisifo sezilwane esilawulwayo ngaphansi kwe-Animal Diseases Act; abezinsizakalo zokwelapha izilwane baphoqelela ukuhlukaniswa nezithiyo zokuthutha.
rows.st: Lefu la tlhako le molomo (FMD) ke lefu la diphoofolo le laolwang tlasa Animal Diseases Act; Ditshebeletso tsa Bongaka ba Diphoofolo di qobella karohano le dithibelo tsa motsamao.
rows.ts: Vuvabyi bya nomu ni swondzo (FMD) i vuvabyi bya swiharhi leri lawuriwaka ehansi ka Animal Diseases Act; Vukorhokeri bya Vutshunguri bya Swiharhi byi sindzisa ku hambanisa ni swipimelo swa ku fambisa.
rows.ve: Vhulwadze ha milenzhe na mulomo (FMD) ndi vhulwadze ha zwifuwo vhu langiwaho nga fhasi ha Animal Diseases Act; Tshumelo dza Vhulafhi ha Zwifuwo dzi kombetshedza u khethekanya na thivhelo dza u tshimbidza.

rows.english: Inside a declared FMD zone, sheep and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within it without a state veterinary permit.
rows.zu: Endaweni emenyezelwe njengeyokulawula i-FMD, izimvu nemikhiqizo yazo azikwazi ukuthuthelwa ngaphakathi, ngaphandle, noma ngaphakathi kuyo ngaphandle kwemvume kadokotela wezilwane kahulumeni.
rows.st: Sebakeng se phatlaladitsweng sa FMD, dinku le dihlahiswa tsa tsona di ke ke tsa iswa kahare, kantle, kapa kahare ho sona ntle le tumello ya ngaka ya diphoofolo ya mmuso.
rows.ts: Endhawini ya FMD leyi tivisiweke, tinyimpfu ni swikumiwa swa tona a swi nge fambisiwi ku nghena, ku huma, kumbe endzeni ka yona handle ka mpfumelelo wa dokodela wa swiharhi wa mfumo.
rows.ve: Kha dzingu ḽa FMD ḽo ḓivhadzwaho, nngu na zwibveledzwa zwadzo a zwi tei u tshimbidzwa u dzhena, u bva, kana ngomu haḽo hu si na thendelo ya dokotela wa zwifuwo wa muvhuso.

rows.english: Sheep scab is a controlled disease by law: a suspected or positive case must be reported to the State Veterinarian immediately.
rows.zu: Utwayi lwezimvu (sheep scab) luyisifo esilawulwayo ngokomthetho: isigameko esisolekayo noma esiqinisekisiwe kufanele sibikwe masinyane kuDokotela Wezilwane Kahulumeni.
rows.st: Lekgwekgwe la dinku (sheep scab) ke lefu le laolwang ka molao: ketsahalo e belaellwang kapa e netefaditsweng e tlameha ho tlalehwa hanghang ho Ngaka ya Diphoofolo ya Mmuso.
rows.ts: Nhlokonho ya tinyimpfu (sheep scab) i vuvabyi leri lawuriwaka hi nawu: xiendlakalo lexi ehleketeleriwaka kumbe lexi tiyisisiweke xi fanele ku vikiwa hi ku hatlisa eka Dokodela wa Swiharhi wa Mfumo.
rows.ve: Phori ya nngu (sheep scab) ndi vhulwadze vhu langiwaho nga mulayo: zwi humbulelwaho kana zwo khwaṱhisedzwaho zwi tea u vhigwa nga u ṱavhanya kha Dokotela wa Zwifuwo wa Muvhuso.

rows.english: Against sheep scab, all small stock on the farm must be treated with a remedy registered under Act 36 of 1947, and infected sheep treated twice, eight to ten days apart.
rows.zu: Ukulwa notwayi lwezimvu, yonke imfuyo encane epulazini kufanele yelashwe ngomuthi obhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho 36 ka-1947, futhi izimvu ezinalesi sifo zelashwe kabili, ngezikhathi eziqhelelene ngezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kweziyishumi.
rows.st: Ho lwantsha lekgwekgwe la dinku, diphoofolo tsohle tse nyenyane tsa polasi di tlameha ho phekolwa ka moriana o ngodisitsweng tlasa Molao 36 wa 1947, mme dinku tse tshwaeditsweng di phekolwe habedi, ka matsatsi a robedi ho isa ho a leshome pakeng tsa diphekolo.
rows.ts: Ku lwisana ni nhlokonho ya tinyimpfu, swifuwo leswitsongo hinkwato swa le purasini swi fanele ku tshunguriwa hi murhi lowu tsarisiweke ehansi ka Nawu 36 wa 1947, naswona tinyimpfu leti tluleriweke ti tshunguriwa kambirhi, ku hundza masiku ya nhungu ku ya eka khume exikarhini ka matshungulelo.
rows.ve: U lwa na phori ya nngu, zwifuwo zwiṱuku zwoṱhe bulasini zwi tea u lafhiwa nga mushonga wo ṅwaliswaho nga fhasi ha Mulayo 36 wa 1947, nahone nngu dzo kavhiwaho dzi lafhiwe luvhili, hu tshi fhambana maḓuvha a malo u swika fumi vhukati ha u lafha.

rows.english: Every sheep owner must register an official identification mark and mark their sheep with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
rows.zu: Wonke umnikazi wezimvu kufanele abhalise uphawu olusemthethweni lokuhlonza bese emaka izimvu zakhe ngalo, ngaphansi kwe-Animal Identification Act.
rows.st: Mong le e mong wa dinku o tlameha ho ngodisa letshwao la semmuso la boitsebahatso mme a tshwaye dinku tsa hae ka lona, tlasa Animal Identification Act.
rows.ts: N'wini un'wana ni un'wana wa tinyimpfu u fanele ku tsarisa mfungho wa ximfumo wo ti tivekisa kutani a fungha tinyimpfu ta yena ha wona, ehansi ka Animal Identification Act.
rows.ve: Muṋe muṅwe na muṅwe wa nngu u tea u ṅwalisa luswayo lwa tshiofisi lwa u dzi ṱalula na u swaya nngu dzawe ngalwo, nga fhasi ha Animal Identification Act.

rows.english: A sheep may be slaughtered only at an abattoir, except for the farmer's own consumption or for cultural or religious purposes.
rows.zu: Imvu ingahlatshwa kuphela endaweni yokuhlabela, ngaphandle uma kungokokudla komfuyi uqobo noma ngezinjongo zamasiko noma zenkolo.
rows.st: Nku e ka hlajwa feela sehlabelong, ntle le bakeng sa dijo tsa morui ka boyena kapa merero ya setso kapa ya bodumedi.
rows.ts: Nyimpfu yi nga tlhaviwa ntsena laha ku tlhaveriwaka kona, handle ka loko ku ri swakudya swa murimi hi yexe kumbe hi swikongomelo swa ndhavuko kumbe vukhongeri.
rows.ve: Nngu i nga ṱhavhiwa fhedzi fhethu ha u ṱhavhela zwifuwo, nga nnḓa ha zwiḽiwa zwa mulimi nga ene muṋe kana ndivho dza mvelele kana vhurereli.

rows.english: Despite foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in South Africa, wool exports continue under the inactivation clause of the OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health) rules.
rows.zu: Naphezu kwesifo samatele (FMD) eNingizimu Afrika, ukuthunyelwa koboya emazweni angaphandle kuyaqhubeka ngaphansi kwesigatshana sokwenza igciwane lingasebenzi semithetho ye-OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health).
rows.st: Leha ho na le lefu la tlhako le molomo (FMD) Afrika Borwa, diyantle tsa boya di tswela pele tlasa karolo ya ho etsa hore kokwanahloko e se hlole e sebetsa ya melao ya OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health).
rows.ts: Hambiswiritano ni vuvabyi bya nomu ni swondzo (FMD) eAfrika-Dzonga, ku rhumeriwa ka voya ematikweni mambe ku ya mahlweni ehansi ka xiyenge xo endla leswaku xitsongwatsongwana xi nga ha tirhi xa milawu ya OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health).
rows.ve: Naho hu na vhulwadze ha milenzhe na mulomo (FMD) Afrika Tshipembe, u rengisela vhukuse kha maṅwe mashango zwi bvela phanḓa nga fhasi ha tshipiḓa tsha u ita uri tshitshili tshi si tsha shuma tsha milayo ya OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health).

rows.english: Wool from scab-infected sheep must be destroyed rather than sent to the buyer, where it would be marked as scab wool.
rows.zu: Uboya bezimvu ezinotwayi kufanele bubhujiswe kunokuba buthunyelwe kumthengi, lapho bebungamakwa njengoboya obunotwayi.
rows.st: Boya ba dinku tse tshwaeditsweng ke lekgwekgwe bo tlameha ho senngwa ho ena le ho romelwa moreking, moo bo neng bo tla tshwauwa e le boya ba lekgwekgwe.
rows.ts: Voya bya tinyimpfu leti tluleriweke hi nhlokonho byi fanele ku lovisiwa ematshan'weni yo rhumeriwa eka muxavi, laha byi nga ta funghiwa ku va voya bya nhlokonho.
rows.ve: Vhukuse ha nngu dzo kavhiwaho nga phori vhu tea u fheliswa nṱhani ha u rumelwa kha murengi, hune ha vha ho ḓo swaiwa sa vhukuse ha phori.
